title: Incidence and characteristics of sudden cardiac arrest in Bavaria
summary:
As part of the project, the incidence and emergency medical care of prehospital cardiac resuscitations (out-of-hospital cardiac arrest – OHCA) in the federal state of Bavaria will be investigated using data from the integrated control centers and the emergency medical service records from 2018 to 2023.

Particular attention will be paid to sudden cardiac arrest (SCA) and sudden cardiac death (SCD). Using these data, the aim is to identify risk factors for the occurrence of sudden cardiac death in order to develop preventive measures.

interventions.name: Retrospective collection of prehospital data from all individuals who had contact with emergency medical services in Bavaria between January 1, 2018, and December 31, 2023, due to sudden cardiac arrest.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
The study will retrospectively include all cases between January 1, 2018, and December 31, 2023, in which individuals had contact with emergency medical services in Bavaria due to an unspecified cardiopulmonary resuscitation or a documented cardiac arrest of cardiac origin, and for whom dispatch data and medical records were electronically recorded.
Exclusion criteria:
None
